title: Exclude the tempting local positive-gadget route for correlated Pauli faults
statement: An exact local representation obstruction leaves global correlated decoding and usable cost as the decisive opening.

evidence.quote: ## 6. The decisive unresolved operation: retain physical correlations

requires: One Pauli-error sector of a planar surface code encoding ONE logical qubit over a finite window of repeated noisy syndrome measurements. Independent binary graphlike fault mechanisms; contractible spacetime region with two distinct connected rough boundary components; known initialization or preparation faults included. Actual finite code/boundary matrices satisfy H_check=(B_H)_internal and im S_stabilizer=ker B_H,checked by the source-prescribed binary elimination on the actual supplied code. For unknown-rate calibration: stationary rates across independent repetitions of the SAME schedule,bounded detector degreeDelta,and promised fixed0<p_min<=p_e<=p_max<1/2. Calibration identifiability requires the stated unique interior-edge/separable boundary factors; no detector may hide distinct factors to both rough components,and parallel mechanisms merge only with the same detector incidence AND logical effect. A separated distance>=3 patch is the supplied sufficient example. External general nonnegative perfect-matching counting FPRAS has relative accuracy1+/-eta and worst-case polynomial bit time,includinglog(1/delta),as explicitly named in the source. Calibration/model promises do not certify arbitrary hardware noise.
provides: For one depolarizing fault with distinct ports a,b forX and c,d forZ,F(empty)=1-p,F(ab)=F(cd)=F(abcd)=p/3,and other two-port patterns forbidden. Every nonnegative perfect-matching gadget with arbitrary hidden vertices satisfies F(empty)*F(abcd)<=F(ab)F(cd)+F(ac)F(bd)+F(ad)F(bc),by the source-attributed Liu-Meng alternating-path inequality.

The physical signature would require p(1-p)/3<=p^2/9,violated by p(3-4p)/9>0 for0<p<3/4. Positive port rescaling cannot repair it. Enlarging LOCAL nonnegative matching gadgets therefore does not absorb ordinary low-noise X/Z correlation. This is NOT a hardness theorem or no-go for all correlated decoders/global representations.

The selected unresolved operation is joint logical-class weight computation for COUPLED spacetime ensembles retaining actual local Pauli factors,controlled relative error and usable cost. A new global representation or rigorously controlled correlation treatment is required;independent-sector marginals alone are not that operation.

The source quotes a matching-proof comparison constant proportional to(10N)^80*r^9. Keep r source-local;the visible source does not define it as code distance/rate. Polynomial existence is not demonstrated latency,even for the completed independent reference model. Historical priority of the composition and practical fault-tolerant capability remain unestablished.
assumptions: Completed source-reported independent-graphlike reference case is not the selected full correlation-aware physical decoder. Local Pauli X/Z correlations and coupled spacetime joint class weights remain missing; a four-port obstruction excludes LOCAL nonnegative matching gadgets,not all global representations or a hardness theorem. No general matching FPRAS was implemented/benchmarked; polynomial existence and a large proof comparison constant do not establish useful decoder latency or practical advantage. Unknown-rate calibration is polynomial in p_min^-1 and inverse moment bounds,not merely rate-description bit length; fixed rate bounds and bounded degree matter. Destructive logical readout consumes the encoded state and provides classical output,not a coherent quantum decoder port. Arbitrary topology/many logical qubits,non-Pauli/coherent or nonstationary/misspecified hardware noise are outside the earned model. No new Capital/root scientific verification/audit,physical experiment,novelty/priority certification or completed civilisation-level capability is claimed. Source UI explanations and source-reported finite checks are not independent audits.
costs: Let m be fault mechanisms,Delta detector degree,a=(1-2p_max)^(2Delta). For supplied rational rates,positive weighted matching reduces to unweighted usingO(logW_e) integer gadgets and denominator scaling,polynomial in rational input length. Counter complexity must include relative accuracy,graph/input length andlog(delta_counter^-1). Pay total failure delta_total<=epsilon*p_min^m/2 when both sectors feasible,so log delta_total^-1=O(m log p_min^-1+log epsilon^-1); no inverse rare-syndrome/logical-error enumeration factor is introduced by the proved weight/risk argument. The source cites a matching-proof comparison constant proportional to(10N)^80*r^9;that source-local r is not silently identified with code distance or fault rate. Calibration shots/data,all FPRAS work,rounding/precision,feasibility checks and actual decoder latency are paid; useful practical cost is not achieved.
